caption:
Today's Sky is Yin Metal, The Jewel 💎 Pause on your Day Master.

Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born. Today's element meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Metal gets a friend day, Yang Water feels supported, Yin Wood feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Comment your Day Master below 👇

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #astrology #knowyourself #metaphysics #bazi #chinesemetaphysics #fiveelements #yinyang #astrologyreels
day_line: A jewel among heavy fruit. Polished and rich: good for treats and details, not for perfectionism.

lines.Yang Wood: A small favour you did gets noticed today. Take the thanks; don't wave it away.
lines.Yin Wood: Weekend chores gang up on you today. Do the worst one first, then go out.
lines.Yang Fire: Weekend sales are calling. Buy what you need, not what's 50% off.
lines.Yin Fire: A random Saturday plan turns out useful. Go, but catch the last MRT home.
lines.Yang Earth: You have opinions on brunch, movies, everything today. Share one, listen to two.
lines.Yin Earth: Cook something for someone today. Messy kitchen allowed; burnt rice is not.
lines.Yang Metal: Someone wants your Saturday table or parking spot. Let it go; find a better one.
lines.Yin Metal: Good day for your inner circle. Small group, long chat, phones off the table.
lines.Yang Water: Visit family or call someone older today. You'll leave with food and good advice.
lines.Yin Water: A quiet Saturday suits you. Read, wander, think. Reply to the group chat later.
